title: A finite family of vectors has a linearly independent subfamily with the same span
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], $V$ an $F$-vector space and $v_1,\ldots,v_m\in V$. Then there is a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,m\}$ such that the family $(v_i)_{i\in S}$ is linearly independent over $F$ and spans the same $F$-linear subspace of $V$ as $v_1,\ldots,v_m$.
